ui_bugs.issue: COMPILE-BLOCKING: react-hooks/rules-of-hooks violation. Local functions defined at lines 279 (`useRental`) and 289 (`dismissRental`) — the name `useRental` matches the Hook naming convention. ESLint flags `useRental(r)` on line 760 with 'React Hook "useRental" cannot be called inside a callback.' CRA treats this lint error as a build error → webpack-dev-server-client-overlay iframe covers the entire page and blocks all clicks (login submit intercepted, /trip-inspection unreachable). Fix: rename `useRental` → `applyRental` (or similar non-`use*` name) at definition site (line 279) and at the call site (line 760).

rca of the issue: Root cause of frontend outage: E1 introduced a helper named `useRental` (line 279 of TripInspection.jsx). React's ESLint plugin infers Hook-ness from the `use` prefix; calling `useRental(r)` inside an onClick arrow function is flagged as a rules-of-hooks violation, which CRA promotes to a hard compile error. The dev server serves a full-page error overlay (iframe#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) that intercepts pointer events, so no test — human or automated — can reach the login form or the trip-inspection page. Mitigation: rename to `applyRental` (and update the single call site on line 760). Zero backend impact.
